column4: The same tall stained-glass window and the same serene icon of the girl, same pose, arms low and open, palms up. Change one thing: the whole figure, including her face, neck and hands, is assembled from many separate pieces of glass joined by thick coal lead lines, just like her dress. Lead lines cross her cheeks, forehead, nose bridge and chin, dividing the face into several irregular shards while her features stay readable and calm; the hair and flower are also split into separate panes. It should feel fragile, as if it could shatter along those lines.

The same three side stained-glass windows with the same three poses of the girl. Change one thing: in every window her face, neck and hands are also built from several separate glass pieces joined by thick coal lead lines crossing the cheeks, forehead and chin, like her dress, so the figures feel fragile and breakable while staying readable.
